parsed.explanation: Rated as a division under a parent regime. The parent sets the baseline: passport sex-marker restrictions, border and secondary-screening exposure, stranding, national facility bans, and documented harm in immigration and federal custody, scoring around 0.35. The division's own statutes move it up materially: gender-identity nondiscrimination in public accommodations since 2001, hate-crime enhancements, panic defence repealed in 2018, shield-law listing, self-declared marker changes, and no state bathroom ban or trans-specific offence in the record. The rating stops short of Reduced Risk because the dossier says visitor exposure at airports, national buildings and borders does not track state law. It also has no enforcement data, no complaint outcomes and no dated incident record, so the protections are documented in force but not shown to operate for visitors. The school-sports revision is policy text only and is not credited.
